holes.note: Rim Shot: the opener, along the canyon rim; the river crosses 330 yards out, in front of the green
First Leap: the fairway bends right; the river crosses the driving zone at 280: lay up or carry it
The Gorge: from the rim, straight over the gorge
The Decision: a par 5 of choices; carry the river off the tee (150 yards out)
Lay Up or Leap: long and straight; the river crosses the driving zone at 230: lay up or carry it
Long Gorge: a long iron in to a narrow green; the river crosses the driving zone at 230: lay up or carry it
Diagonal: the river slants across it: bite off as much as you dare; the river crosses the driving zone at 220: lay up or carry it
The Butte: the green is on a butte in the middle of the river; the rope bridge takes you on to the far bank
Turn Back: down at the bend; carry the river off the tee (70 yards out)
Sidewinder: a long climb up the far rim; the river crosses 310 yards out, in front of the lay-up
Copper Rim: to a green on the copper-red rim; the river crosses the driving zone at 230: lay up or carry it
Sunscar: off the highest rim over the deepest stretch of the gorge
The Elbow: a dogleg left; the river crosses the driving zone at 250: lay up or carry it
Crown Butte: short, but the green sits in a crown of bunkers; carry the river off the tee (120 yards out)
Rimrock: it runs along the canyon, the river creeping in from one side; the river crosses the driving zone at 300: lay up or carry it
Long Haul: the longest hole on the course; the river crosses 410 yards out, in front of the lay-up
Flash Flood: a short iron to a small green
Homecoming: home to the green below the clubhouse; carry the river off the tee (130 yards out)
